_file: damned_waters/game/data/rooms/thorbeckeplein.json — RoomSpec for Thorbeckeplein (the city storey): the short wide street of bars, clubs, a coffeeshop and restaurants running from the Herengracht up to Rembrandtplein, its middle a strip of plane trees hung with strings of bulbs over the terraces. Modelled after openly licensed night photos; every business name is made up. The power is still on; nobody is there. Outdoor: no walls or roof of its own (street.py and city.py build it). Single source of truth for Blender (render) and the engine (collision, cameras, things).
